title: Why Autism Rates Depend On Where A Child Is Screened
hook: Where a child is screened can change their autism diagnosis entirely.
closing: Autism rates need screening context before anyone treats one number as universal.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Measured autism prevalence hit 32.2 per thousand children, up sharply over the last two decades.
Boys are diagnosed far more often than girls -- at more than three times the rate.
The California site measured 52.6 per thousand, more than five times the Laredo site's rate.
